content.text:
**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

- No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalties, or minimum/early-termination fees exist anywhere in the Agreement — this meets the **preferred** position, so no redline was proposed.
- §6.1: IBM may cancel any and all Purchase Orders at any time; no cancellation charge on MSL default, only cost reimbursement under the Price section.
- §§5.1–5.3 and 5.2 b): termination consequences are cost-based purchases of completed/partially completed Product and Parts (with cancellable/transferable Parts excluded), not a liquidated sum.
- §13.0 f)/Appendix 2 (requirements-accuracy liabilities) and §9.0 premium cost are actual-exposure reimbursement/pricing mechanics, not breach penalties; §13.2 e) confirms IBM has no liability for unused flexibility.
- The express "penalty" and delivery-performance mechanics (Shipment Profit Rate deductions, §§10.2/10.4) operate against MSL and benefit us, so they are not flagged.
